content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The layout overflows the phone width, clipping the hero text and pushing the closing call-to-action text beyond its dark background.",
  "desktopNote": "The bold typography and electrical imagery work well, but oversized sections and a late location cue weaken the hierarchy and make the page unnecessarily long.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 2,
    "hierarchy": 1,
    "imagery": 3,
    "spacing": 2,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 3
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Make every phone section fit within 360px: remove minimum-width overflow, allow long headings to wrap, and reduce mobile headline sizes so text stays inside its background.",
    "Rebalance the hero with a shorter phone image, a smaller headline, and a visible location cue alongside the service introduction.",
    "Tighten the service-list gaps and oversized experience and regional sections, and consolidate the repeated phone and directions details into one contact section."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone hero: the headline, introductory text and image label are clipped at the right edge.",
    "Phone closing call-to-action: the heading and paragraph overflow the dark panel, leaving white text unreadable on the white area beside it."
  ]
}
